question.text: Taking Rydberg's constant $\mathrm{R}_{\mathrm{H}}=1.097 \times 10^{7} \mathrm{~m}$, first and second wavelength of Balmer series in hydrogen spectrum is

solution.text:
$\frac{1}{\lambda}=\mathrm{R}\left[\frac{1}{\mathrm{n}_{1}^{2}}-\frac{1}{\mathrm{n}_{2}^{2}}\right]$. For first wavelength, $\mathrm{n}_{1}$
$$
=2, \mathrm{n}_{2}=3
$$
$\Rightarrow \lambda_{1}=6563 \AA$. For second wavelength, $\mathrm{n}_{1}$
$=2, \mathrm{n}_{2}=4 \Rightarrow \lambda_{2}=4861 \AA$
